thread:
Annie_CustomerSuccess: Heads-up — ZenFlo onboarding flagged. They want clear SLO/SLA visibility ahead of renewal next month. We promised 99.9% uptime and p95 latency < 300ms. Need: current report, any credit exposure, and a one-pager for their CSM call.
Mike_Infra: I can pull the last 30d metrics. Quick Q: do we present 24/7 canonical window or business-hours view (M–F 9–5 PT)? Also, do we include Dedicated failovers in the uptime calc? @Luis_SRE any objections.
Luis_SRE: No objections. We maintain both synthetic and real-traffic checks. Quick figures for last 30d: `uptime_24_7 = 99.88% (2 incidents)` `uptime_biz_hours = 99.93%` `median_latency = 180ms` `p95_latency = 410ms`. Incidents: 7m and 4m. I'll paste incident notes and timeline in a follow-up.
Annie_CustomerSuccess: Perfect — please produce both views (canonical 24/7 + biz-hours) and a short incident summary for each. Sales wants a credits estimate in case canonical falls under 99.9%.
Henry_Sales: Quick clarity: what's our credit formula for Standard commitment? Need the exact calc so I can draft the renewal comms.
Sarah_CS: Policy link: <https://redwood.example.com/sla-policy>. For Standard tier we use: "monthly credit = 0.5% of monthly fees per 0.1% below target". Example calc: target=99.9, observed=99.88 => delta=0.02 (percentage points) => delta_fraction = 0.02 / 0.1 = 0.2 => credit = 0.5% * 0.2 = 0.1% of monthly fees. I'll attach the policy snippet to the thread.
Mike_Infra: I'll export the 30d chart + raw uptime CSV and create a PDF SLO report. Also can pin a synthetic alert for p95 > 350ms so we have proactive signals during the renewal window.
Annie_CustomerSuccess: Action items: 1) Mike — export charts + PDF SLO report (both windows) and upload to the ZenFlo customer folder; 2) Luis — incident summaries + root causes and mitigations; 3) Henry — draft customer-facing note with credit estimate and proposed language; 4) Sarah — attach policy excerpt. I'll run a prep call with ZenFlo PO tomorrow 10:00am PT. Please ack and add any blockers. :thumbsup:
Henry_Sales: ACK. Drafting comms now. Noted: loop legal if credit > 0.3% or if they push for a retroactive SLA amendment.
Luis_SRE: Incident summaries (brief): - Incident A: region deploy + autoscaler race -> 7m outage, rollback + hotfix applied. - Incident B: cache stampede on a new feature -> 4m degradation, increased cache TTL and patch deployed. Will add logs and timeline to the export.
Annie_CustomerSuccess: Great, this should be enough for the customer call. Also capture onboarding feedback: ZenFlo asked for a short "latency SLO explainer" in our onboarding playbook — can someone add that as a small doc blurb?
Mike_Infra: I can add a one-paragraph explainer and link the dashboard screenshots. Will do by EOD.
Sarah_CS: Uploaded the policy snippet and a short example calc into the ZenFlo folder. Leaving a note for legal review in case they push credits beyond typical thresholds.
Annie_CustomerSuccess: Thanks team. I'll schedule the call and share the PDF report ahead of time. If anything changes, ping here.
Henry_Sales: :thumbsup: will prepare the renewal slide with these numbers.
Mike_Infra: Export done — uploaded `zenflo_slo_report_30d.pdf` and `zenflo_uptime_30d.csv` to the customer folder.
Annie_CustomerSuccess: Closing loop — we have everything needed for the call. Follow-ups: attach incident logs to the support ticket and note the biz-hours view in the slide deck.
summary: SLO visibility + credit calc prep for ZenFlo renewal: exports, incident summaries, two-window reporting (24/7 + biz-hours), credit estimate, and onboarding doc request.
